not_checked: FEA of the shell, frames, roof hardpoints or hatch surround
Sealing performance (water/dust ingress): needs a physical test
Real-truck fit: every truck value is Rivian-illustration-derived; tape session required
Latch endurance, salt spray, UV: vendor qualification data not obtained
Rotor/pawl internals: a representation (G6); rotor-vs-striker contact is not a rigid sweep
GN 7233 coupler curve (G5): hatch sweep assumes pure rotation about the design pivot
Fabrication release, tooling, prototype fit, purchases, Nate-only design approval

Attachment: Port Latch Foot hook / paddle / lock force, over-centre preload, detent force, port strength beyond Rivian's 2,500 N rating, crash retention, rail/foot bond strength and fatigue - load cases and the hand strength check are stated assumptions, not FEA or test
Attachment: the port internals and the Rivian crossbar foot are NOT published - every PLF dimension at the port is PROVISIONAL until calibration P-CAL-01b (a physical Rivian crossbar + port)
